描述_ZN: The Prince of Yong inscribed screen of the deep dwelling in the Hall of Books - Bo Gu Pondering" scroll, Qing dynasty, painted by the court painter, on silk, color, 184 cm long, 98 cm wide.    This is one of the twelve panels of the screen entitled "The Deep Dwelling in the Hall of Books", formerly known as the screen of "Yinzhen's Concubine's Music". This set of picture screen is Yinzhen ordered the painter for his imperial garden Yuanmingyuan custom-made, originally posted in the Yuanmingyuan "deep willow reading hall" within the screen, Yongzheng ten years (1732) in August before the decree to remove them from the screen into the Forbidden City.    This set of picture screen uses the method of heavy painting, which not only shows the aesthetic interest of elegant and noble palace painting and the artistic characteristics of neat and beautiful painting of ladies, but also realistically reproduces the crown, hairstyle, jewelry of court ladies and the furniture and porcelain in the room, such as "imitating Song official kiln", "imitating Ru kiln" and "imitating the porcelain" painted in the picture, "imitation Ru kiln", "Lang kiln red glaze" porcelain, as well as furniture "huanghuali Duo BaoGe", "spotted bamboo table and chairs" etc., are the most prevalent varieties of furniture and furnishings from Kangxi to Yongzheng period. Women wear the headdress, bracelets, etc. also reflects the distinctive characteristics of the times, was the most popular style in the palace, and has the royal supplies exquisite production techniques, exquisite material characteristics.
